countBasis: One MCQ per distinct high-yield decision. The original 43-item map expanded to 44 after review identified a missing NMDAR encephalitis recognition/confirmation decision; this is not an official examination weight or uniform quota.

crossChapterBoundaries: PD motor therapy and RBD treatment were covered in Chapter 7; this chapter focuses on cognitive classification and Lewy body dementia care.
CNS infection treatment was covered in Chapter 5; infection exclusion remains explicit when discussing autoimmune encephalitis and rapid decline.
Vascular cognitive decisions do not repeat the full reperfusion and stroke-prevention algorithms.
Anti-amyloid dosing, MRI surveillance and ARIA are included because they directly change cognitive-disorder management.
requiredFinalReview: Recheck current anti-amyloid labels and distinguish trial populations, regulator indications and local access.
State biomarker criterion versions and assay limitations; do not present all commercial blood tests as interchangeable.
Verify exact doses, renal adjustments and contraindications for symptomatic treatments.
Review every distractor for plausible competition and every explanation for independent teaching value.
Install only a complete validated chapter and document clinical-review and source-access limits.
